pages.text: A current I flows up one rail, through the armature and back down the other. The rails' field pushes the armature with F = ½L′I² (L′ = 0.5 µH/m) along their 10 m; it leaves at v = √(2FL/m). Hitting the target it drives a shock of pressure P ≈ ½ρv². Shock synthesis needs the right pressure: too low and nothing changes, too high and the target vaporises.
$(thing)Set$(): Current, Armature mass.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Rail contact: the force varies by ±3%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The rails are eroding under the arc.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Smaller currents recharge faster.
